subject: Differential methylation analysis for paired patiend data

messages.author: 9340abd652779041
messages.subject: Differential methylation analysis for paired patiend data
parts:
Hi, I have a set of RRBS data for which I have each patient analysed before and after treatment. I would like to perform differential analysis for paired data so each patient is matched before and after. Is there a way to do this using methylkit? If not do you know any good tool can do it smoothly?
Thanks!

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Differential methylation analysis for paired patiend data
parts:
there is no test specifically designed for paired samples in methylkit. you can try to encode pairs as covariates, but probably it won't be appropriate. 

Best,
Altuna
